title: Hawaiian Waterfall Hike With Waikiki Pickup
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health

blurb:
-Waikīkī pickup and drop off
-Hike to Manoa Falls, featured in Jurassic Park
- Scenic drive through Rainbow Valley with rainbow sightings
- Visit a famous lookout point for panoramic views of Honolulu
-Learn Hawaiian words, culture and history from our expert local tour guides
Escape Waikīkī and enjoy a nature walk to a Hawaiian Waterfall! Discover the lush beauty of Oahu on a self-guided hike to the stunning Manoa Falls, a waterfall made famous by its appearance in Jurassic Park. Departing from Waikiki, this tour offers a scenic drive through Manoa Valley, also known as Rainbow Valley, where rainbows are seen almost daily. Enjoy a refreshing trek to the falls, and on your way back, take in breathtaking views from a famous lookout.
